properties.name: MEASURED 2026-10-07: add_component, creating without a description, is refused with "`purpose` is required ... pass `purpose`", and passing `purpose` is refused as an unknown field (the field is `description`). The refusal names the stored property, not the tool's field
properties.statement: Met while writing a test (crates/reflow2-mcp/tests/a_ripple_is_carried_on_with_arriving_from.rs) through the served tool. First refusal, verbatim: "`purpose` is required to CREATE Component 'cmp:b-engine', and no such node exists yet to take it from... If you meant to create this node, pass `purpose`". Following it, the deserialiser refused: "unknown field `purpose`, expected one of `id`, `name`, `description`, `level`, `kind`, `distinct_from`, `replaces`, `tier`, `status`". CAUSE, read in the code: crates/reflow2-mcp/src/tools/capture.rs:2437 calls the required-field helper as __rf.str("purpose", req.description), passing the core property's name where every other constructor passes the request field's name. The class: a refusal built from a hand-written field name that nothing checks against the published schema. Same family as fact:defect-add-epoch-requires-a-sequence-the-refusal-cannot-name-because-the-required-field-helper-is-generic.
